ask_history_policy: ask calls shared engine with default empty history; source-dependent chat supplies up to 8 messages
claim_support_policy: Same exact quote+ID checks for research and grounded chat; one bounded repair retained
ordinary_chat: 650-token unstructured path unchanged except reachable only without source lookup/carried evidence
new_grounded_chat: 2400-token structured path with specific prompt; every claim still needs semantic reviewer assessment
capability_scope: Generic plural command/capability/tool keywords plus request intent and you/your; required exact phrases retained. No claim that every paraphrase is recognized.
